title: Traditional Slovakian Yellow Pasta
description: A traditional Slovakian take on a simple pasta dish with a yellow twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the Slovakian yellow pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and sauté until softened.
Combine cooked pasta and onion mixture.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Cook to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
